## Description
This portable analytical instrument separates , identify, and quantify individual &#10;&#9;&#9;chemical components in complex mixtures that can be vaporized without decomposition.  &#10;&#9;&#9;It operates by passing a sample through a column using an inert carrier gas (mobile phase), &#10;&#9;&#9;where components separate based on their interactions with a stationary phase.
